title: Structural economic change under the digital transformation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Productivity improvements in digital industries could massively reshape the structure of production networks and drive significant labour reallocation across sectors. We examine these adjustments using a calibrated agent-based model of the global economy. We consider two scenarios with the same cumulative increase in digital-supplier productivity, which differ in how digital inputs in exposed industries are incorporated into production. The key difference is whether digital inputs enter as standard intermediate inputs (low embeddedness) or are combined directly with primary factors (high embeddedness). Across economies, both scenarios generate gains in gross output, household utility, and GDP, although value-added gains are more modest and unevenly distributed across sectors. High embeddedness generally amplifies production responses, particularly in industries highly exposed to digital inputs. Structurally, as digital industries become

translated_title: 数字化转型下的结构性经济变化
translated_abstract: 数字行业生产率的提升可能会大规模重塑生产网络的结构，并推动劳动力在各部门之间的大规模重新配置。我们使用一个经过校准的全球经济基于主体模型来考察这些调整过程。我们考虑了两种情景，二者具有相同的数字供应商生产率累积增长，区别在于受影响行业中的数字投入如何被纳入生产过程。关键差异在于数字投入是作为标准中间投入进入生产（低嵌入性），还是直接与初级要素相结合（高嵌入性）。在各经济体中，两种情景均带来总产出、家庭效用和GDP的增长，尽管增加值的增长较为温和且在各部门之间分布不均。高嵌入性通常会放大生产反应，尤其是在数字投入敞口较高的行业。从结构上看，随着数字行业变得……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用校准的全球经济基于主体模型研究数字行业生产率提升的影响，发现数字投入在生产中的嵌入方式（作为中间投入还是直接与初级要素结合）是关键机制：高嵌入性会显著放大生产响应并驱动劳动力跨部门再配置，而增加值收益在部门间分布不均。
en_tdlr: Using a calibrated agent-based model of the global economy, this paper shows that the degree to which digital inputs are embedded in production—as standard intermediates versus directly combined with primary factors—critically shapes how digital productivity gains propagate through production networks, with high embeddedness amplifying output responses and driving significant labour reallocation despite uneven value-added gains.
